description: Aménagement vélo à Montreuil is a dataset listed in Montreuil Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by © Les contributeurs OpenStreetMap. Couche géographique décrivant les aménagements cyclables linéaires à Montreuil: pistes cyclables, bandes cyclables, zones de rencontre... Qualité La modélisation des aménagements vélo est discutée entre les utilisateurs d'OpenStreetMap. Le modèle est consultable sur cette page. Coverage: Montreuil. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are vélo, Aménagement, Données géographiques, Pistes cyclables. The portal shows 478 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2019-09-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-montreuil-fr-portal.
